source.description: Project Gutenberg 39542, ISO-8859-1 HTML. Complete twelve chapters, front matter, 70 original colour plates and their legends, source footnotes, appended publisher’s catalogue and complete Gutenberg licence. HTML layout whitespace is collapsed for reflow; explicit poetry lines retained. One documented spacing correction against print. Plate-page margins cropped and landscape plates rotated; no colour retouching.
